title: SIU probing death of woman, 24, at Niagara Falls police station
article: Ontario's police watchdog is investigating the death of a 24-year-old woman at a police station in Niagara Falls.
The Special Investigations Unit says Niagara Regional Police arrested the woman around 5 p.m. Wednesday in the Kitchener St. and Slater Ave. area for breaching conditions.
The SIU says police took her to the station and lodged her in a cell.
The woman left her cell around 2 p.m. Thursday for a bail hearing by telephone and returned to the cell.
At 4:50 p.m., the watchdog says officers found the woman unresponsive. Paramedics arrived but she could not be saved.
The SIU is an arm's-length investigates reports involving police where there has been a serious injury, death or allegations of sexual assault.
